description: Core APIs (events for PTY streaming, window) + native folder dialog + open external URLs (any http(s) link, handed to the OS default browser — non-web schemes like file:// stay blocked) + scoped HTTP to the Chief API. Single-window shell (CM-U7): the one 'main' app window plus the helper-island and capture webviews — no runtime window creation. A window whose label is absent here gets ZERO permissions, including event.listen — which is silent until runtime. core:window:default only grants the READ side of the window API, so every mutation the frontend calls needs an explicit core:window:allow-set-* entry below — a missing one type-checks and passes CI, then no-ops at runtime (see windowCapabilities.test.ts).
